episodeTitle.zh: Substack平台建设 | 萨钦·蒙加（Substack、Facebook）

guestBioOfficial.en: Sachin Monga is the Head of Product at Substack, a platform that I personally use every day, and love. Before Substack, Sachin co-founded an app called Cocoon, which he ended up selling to Substack. Before that, he spent over seven years at Facebook as a PM working on video and camera products, building out the developer platform, and leading the ads growth team. In today’s episode, we dive deep on all things Substack. Sachin shares what it’s like transitioning from a large product team at Facebook to a small growth team. He discusses how to work with a hands-on founder and why you must be comfortable with rapid change in a PM role. He also shares unique features of Substack that make it an optimized experience for readers and writers, how he’d like to see it improved, and tips for anyone wanting to get started writing online.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 萨钦·蒙加是Substack的首席产品官，我个人每天都在使用并喜爱这个平台。在加入Substack之前，萨钦联合创立了一款名为Cocoon的应用，最终将其出售给Substack。此前，他在Facebook担任产品经理七余年，负责视频和相机产品、开发者平台建设，并领导广告增长团队。在本期节目中，我们将深入探讨Substack的方方面面。萨钦分享了从Facebook大型产品团队向Substack小型增长团队过渡的经历，讲述了如何与亲力亲为的创始人合作，以及PM岗位为何必须适应快速变化的环境。他还分享了Substack为读者和作者优化体验的独特功能，谈及希望改进的方向，并为有意开启在线写作之路的人们提供建议。

title.zh: Substack平台建设 | 萨钦·蒙加（Substack、Facebook）

summary.en: Sachin walks through how Substack builds product as it transitions into a product-driven company, structured around writer, reader, and growth teams. He shares lessons from the legendary Substack Recommendations feature, and how he navigates working with a strong product-minded founder (Chris Best) as head of product. The episode is a rare look at the product engine behind a platform that reshaped independent writing and publishing.
summary.zh: Sachin 拆解了 Substack 在向“产品驱动型公司”转型过程中如何打造产品，其组织围绕“作者团队、读者团队与增长团队”展开。他分享了传奇功能“Substack 推荐（Recommendations）”的经验，以及作为产品负责人如何与产品思维极强的创始人（Chris Best）共事。本期罕见地揭示了重塑独立写作与出版平台的背后产品引擎。
